__user_free=fn[T](p:&mut T);
free = cfn(p:*void);
opaque_alloc = cfn(n:usize)->*void;
Base0 = struct { raw:*void, payload:int };
Box0 = struct[T] { inner:T };
Deep0 = struct[T] { inner:Box0[Box0[T]] };
Shell0 = struct[K, V] { key:K, inner:Deep0[V] };
free_base_impl_0 = fn(x:&mut Base0) { free(x.raw) };
free_box_impl_0 = fn[T](x:&mut Box0[T]) { __user_free(&mut x.inner) };
free_deep_impl_0 = fn[T](x:&mut Deep0[T]) { free_box_impl_0(&mut x.inner) };
free_shell_impl_0 = fn[K, V](x:&mut Shell0[K, V]) { __user_free(&mut x.key); free_deep_impl_0(&mut x.inner) };
